title: Preference-Guided Cooperation in Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.35736v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-objective multi-agent reinforcement learning (MOMARL) addresses agent coordination and objective trade-offs simultaneously while optimising overall system performance. Existing work tends to treat multi-agent cooperation and multi-objective optimisation as largely independent components of a learning problem, which amounts to an exorbitant complexity except in trivial cases. We study here whether the structure provided by multiple objectives can itself be exploited to facilitate cooperation, rather than being treated as an additional optimisation challenge. We formulate MOMARL at both the team and individual levels and introduce objective-wise counterfactual credit assignment to evaluate each agent's contribution across the team objectives. translated_title: 多目标多智能体强化学习中的偏好引导协作
translated_abstract: 多目标多智能体强化学习（MOMARL）在优化整体系统性能的同时，需要同时处理智能体协调与目标权衡问题。现有工作倾向于将多智能体协作和多目标优化视为学习问题中基本相互独立的组成部分，除了在平凡情况下，这会带来过高的复杂度。本研究探讨了多个目标所提供的结构本身是否可以被利用来促进协作，而不是将其视为额外的优化挑战。我们在团队和个人两个层面对MOMARL进行建模，并引入目标级反事实信用分配来评估每个智能体在团队各目标上的贡献。我们提出了元梯度信息引导的多目标多智能体强化学习方法（MIRL），包含静态（MIRL-S）和动态（MIRL-D）两种变体。通过融合元梯度信息，MIRL……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出元梯度信息引导的多目标多智能体强化学习方法（MIRL），将多目标结构本身作为促进协作的手段，并通过目标级反事实信用分配评估各智能体对团队目标的贡献，从而将协作与多目标优化统一为同一问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Meta-Gradient Informed Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MIRL), which unifies cooperation and multi-objective optimization by exploiting the multi-objective structure itself, using objective-wise counterfactual credit assignment to assess each agent's contribution to team objectives.
